property_summary: For every caller who is the current owner, calling setOwner(newOwner) results in c.owner() == newOwner; the mutant that overwrites owner with address(0) violates this because for some fuzzed newOwner values the final owner becomes address(0) instead of the supplied value.
change_summary: Insert an extra assignment that sets owner to address(0) after assigning the provided _owner, causing owner to end up as zero address.
